text:
priya: Quick note — reranker-v2b PTQ smoke shows -0.028 NDCG@10 and -0.015 MRR@10 vs fp16 on smoke-30k. No weight diffs; only ingest template tweaks.

matt: What tweaks? delim/priming/whitespace?

priya: Changed doc joiner to literal '<SEP>' and added a 64-token __PRIME_PAD__ region. Eval: `./eval/run.py --model rerank-v2b-int8 --holdout smoke-30k --k 10 --seed 7`. Logs: https://artifacts.redwood/431000 (summary csv).

jon: Two lightweight probes: 1) revert joiner at eval time (replace '<SEP>' -> '\n\n'), 2) strip prime pad from front of queries before tokenization. If either recovers large chunk then it's formatting. Also dump seqlen hist: `tools/seqhist --input smoke-30k.jsonl --tok rerank-v2b`.

eval-bot: Job started: 22001 (variants baseline, revert-joiner, strip-prime, combined). Artifacts: https://console.redwood/jobs/22001.

priya: Results in: revert-joiner recovered +0.024 NDCG@10, strip-prime +0.008, combined +0.033 (negligible delta vs fp16). Seqlen mean up ~5.5% under new ingest; 95th up ~11%.

matt: That pins it to formatting/distribution shift. Action items: add formatting-parity preproc for bringup, add seqlen-drift alert (>5% mean or 95th), and require a normalized-pipeline FP16 vs INT8 diff with NDCG@10 delta <= 0.01 before promoting quant models.

jon: Filed INF-4098: "reranker-v2b bringup: formatting parity + seqlen guardrails" with repro and tiny normalizer. Pushing preproc patch and will re-run full PTQ flow. Per-query deltas saved to job artifacts.

priya: Will post sign-off after the patched run. If anyone wants per-slice CSV ping me. :white_check_mark:
